say:1:1013820001:1.text: Hello hello! Welcome, ladies and gentlemen!
say:1:1013820001:1.source_cn: 早上中午晚上好，女士们先生们！

say:2:1013820002:1.text: I'm the clown Berial, here to entertain! Anything interesting happened in the last few millennia? I've been trapped for far too long...
say:2:1013820002:1.source_cn: 小丑贝利尔在此。最近几千年发生了什么有趣的事吗？我可被...

say:4:1013820003:1.text: Magister! He must be a Hypogean, since he came from the Hypogean Rift.
say:4:1013820003:1.source_cn: 主人，他是从恶魔裂隙里冒出来的，所以他是……恶魔？
say:4:1013820003:1.male: Magister! He must be a Hypogean, since he came from the Hypogean Rift.
say:4:1013820003:1.female: Magister! He must be a Hypogean, since he came from the Hypogean Rift.

say:5:1013820004:1.text: I told you, I'm a clown. Stop getting hung up on labels. Why can't you just enjoy my show? Your expression changes when you talk about Hypogeans...
say:5:1013820004:1.source_cn: 都说了，我是小丑。何必拘泥于字眼呢？你们可以尽情享受小...

say:6:1013820005:1.text: That makes me sad! Have you heard the joke about the sad clown going to the doctor and the doctor prescribing him medication? The prescription was—
say:6:1013820005:1.source_cn: 我真伤心。听过那个笑话吗？小丑忧郁地去看医生，医生给他...

say:7:1013820006:1.text: The liver of a chubby hamster, taken while it's alive. Ah... I bet it would be quite delicious!
say:7:1013820006:1.source_cn: 一只肥仓鼠的肝脏，活取服用。啊……我敢保证一定很鲜美。

say:10:1013820008:1.text: Then are you planning on cooking your hamster, plating it, and serving it to me?
say:10:1013820008:1.source_cn: 莫非您打算把您的仓鼠煮熟，端在盘子里送给我？
say:10:1013820008:1.male: Then are you planning on cooking your hamster, plating it, and serving it to me?
say:10:1013820008:1.female: Then are you planning on cooking your hamster, plating it, and serving it to me?

say:11:1013820009:1.text: No? Then, I'd rather not eat it.
say:11:1013820009:1.male: No? Then, I'd rather not eat it.
say:11:1013820009:1.female: No? Then, I'd rather not eat it.

say:12:1013820010:1.text: You sure know how to spoil the mood. I admit, you've piqued my interest.
say:12:1013820010:1.source_cn: 您真懂得如何扫兴。我承认，这反倒引起我的兴趣。
say:12:1013820010:1.male: You sure know how to spoil the mood. I admit, you've piqued my interest.
say:12:1013820010:1.female: You sure know how to spoil the mood. I admit, you've piqued my interest.

say:13:1013820014:1.text: Magister Merlin, I'm beginning to take quite a liking to you. I might even perform exclusively for you if you can afford it.
say:13:1013820014:1.source_cn: 梅林，我真中意您。我甚至想只为您一人表演，前提是您出得...
say:13:1013820014:1.male: Magister Merlin, I'm beginning to take quite a liking to you. I might even perform exclusively for you if you can afford it.
say:13:1013820014:1.female: Magister Merlin, I'm beginning to take quite a liking to you. I might even perform exclusively for you if you can afford it.

say:14:1013820015:2.text: How did you know his identity?!
say:14:1013820015:2.source_cn: 你怎么知道主人的身份？！
say:14:1013820015:2.male: How did you know his identity?!
say:14:1013820015:2.female: How did you know her identity?!

say:15:1013820016:1.text: *Giggle* Oh, was it a secret? Well anyways, it looks like there's nothing exciting happening here. If there's no fun, this clown is gonna take off—
say:15:1013820016:1.source_cn: 秘密！看来这里没什么好玩的事了。如无安可，小丑退场——

say:17:1013820017:2.text: Stop! We Templar Knights vowed to guard Dura and her people. No Hypogeans shall escape us and wreak havoc on the world!
say:17:1013820017:2.source_cn: 止步，我等守护艾雅与艾雅子民的圣骑士，决不能允许恶魔出...

say:18:1013820018:2.text: It feels like nothing has changed, even after all this time. The world is still full of boring people...
say:18:1013820018:2.source_cn: 看来这么久过去，什么都没改变。世上还是无趣的人多啊……

say:20:1013820011:1.text: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?
say:20:1013820011:1.source_cn: 我知道，您是仓鼠的饲主。这两只仓鼠，您是打算留着当储备粮吗？
say:20:1013820011:1.male: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?
say:20:1013820011:1.female: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?

choice_prompt:21:1013820011.source_cn: 我知道，您是仓鼠的饲主。这两只仓鼠，您是打算留着当储备粮吗？

choice_prompt:21:1013820011.female: I know, I know, you're their owner. Are you thinking of keeping them as emergency rations?

say:23:1013820012:2.text: I knew the magister loved us!
say:23:1013820012:2.source_cn: 我就知道主人是真心爱我们的！
say:23:1013820012:2.male: I knew the magister loved us!
say:23:1013820012:2.female: I knew the magister loved us!

say:24:1013820013:2.text: Hey, Chippy's super strong! Uh, wait a minute...
say:24:1013820013:2.source_cn: 不对，满满我可是很壮实的哦！……呃，等一下等一下……
say:24:1013820013:2.male: Hey, Chippy's super strong! Uh, wait a minute...
say:24:1013820013:2.female: Hey, Chippy's super strong! Uh, wait a minute...
